subject: Medford Square Proposed Zoning Amendment
overview: The Medford Community Development Board continued a site plan review hearing for 400 Riverside Avenue and held a working session on the proposed Medford Square zoning amendment.

items.title: 400 Riverside Avenue (SPR-2026-1)
items.summary: The board continued the public hearing for 400 Riverside Avenue to March 4, 2026, to allow city staff to finalize reviews regarding fire access and ADA sidewalk compliance.

items.title: Medford Square District Proposed Zoning Amendment
items.summary: The board held a working session with land planning consultant Innes Land Strategies Group to review proposed sub-district maps, dimensional and height standards, historic asset inventories, and parking regulations for Medford Square.
